name: Sveltia CMS
title: Mica vs. Sveltia CMS
summary: Both are database-free, Git-backed editors with a preview. Sveltia CMS is a static, Decap-compatible app with first-class languages and many media providers. Mica is for Astro, with a preview of the real page. Sveltia suits multilingual sites and a static app with no server of your own.

chooseMica.text: You build with Astro and want an official package, with your content as typed Content Collections.
You want the preview to be the real Astro page, with no preview template to write.
You want sign-in through your OpenID Connect provider, in a container you run.
You keep large files in Git LFS on GitHub, or your content in a Git submodule.
You want AI agents to save drafts through an MCP server that is built into Mica.

chooseOther.text: Your content has several languages, and you want machine translation with your own API key.
You want media in S3, Cloudinary or another provider, not in Git.
You want a two-pane live preview with scroll sync, from React templates of your own.
You want an address search on the map field.
Your Git host is GitLab or Gitea, and you want a static app with no server to run.

facts.value: Yes. GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo and Codeberg. Bitbucket and Azure are not documented. Local mode uses the File System Access API of the browser (Chromium only).
Self-hosting: a static app. GitHub OAuth needs a server. GitLab and Gitea use PKCE without a server. Personal access tokens also work. A hosted service is not documented.
No. It caches in the IndexedDB of the browser.
config.yml, TOML, JSON or JavaScript. It is compatible with Decap CMS.
A framework guide and community starters. Content Collections read the files.
GitHub OAuth, GitLab and Gitea/Forgejo PKCE, tokens. OIDC and SSO are not documented.
simple: each save commits. preview: changes go to a pull request. editorial_workflow: one pull request for each entry, with statuses. No batch publish documented.

A two-pane live preview with scroll sync, from custom React templates in a sandboxed iframe. Deploy previews of unpublished entries through CI. On 21 October 2026 the roadmap lists an out-of-the-box live site preview as a non-goal.
Documented on GitLab and on Gitea/Forgejo (large files stay outside the normal history). Not documented on GitHub.
Not supported. Local commits are refused in a submodule.
Stores a GeoJSON string. The center and the zoom only set the first view and are not stored. Address search with Nominatim.
Not documented. Relations point to collections or to list items in a file.
Yes, first-class, with machine translation through your own API key.
None documented. An add-on is planned on the roadmap (21 October 2026). Review goes through the editorial workflow.
MCP server: not documented as of 21 October 2026. It has an Agent Skill, llms.txt and AI translation.
